name: The Peninsula Manila
positioning: Peninsula hotel on the corner of Ayala and Makati Avenues in Makati, a double-winged Brutalist building by Filipino architect Gabriel Formoso, with rooms refreshed in contemporary Filipino design
best_for: Travelers who want a Makati base within walking distance of Legazpi Village, Salcedo Village, Poblacion and Greenbelt
Families wanting a kids program with local games and scavenger hunts
Diners interested in French fine dining at Old Manila

facts.text: The hotel is on the corner of Ayala and Makati Avenues in Makati City, Metro Manila.
The hotel is 9 km from Ninoy Aquino International Airport.
The hotel was designed by Filipino architect Gabriel Formoso as a double-winged Brutalist building.
The hotel was built ahead of the 1976 International Monetary Fund conference.
Rooms have been refreshed with contemporary Filipino design, natural textures and views across Makati.
Old Manila serves French fine dining in an Art Deco setting.
Old Manila has been open since 1976.
In 2026, Old Manila and Spices are MICHELIN-selected.
The spa area has saunas and steam rooms.
A program for young guests includes local games, scavenger hunts and exercise classes.
From the hotel, guests can walk to Legazpi Village, Salcedo Village, Poblacion and the Greenbelt Mall complex.

highlights.text: The triple-height Lobby is crowned with a sculpture of bronze, copper and steel that resembles a bursting sun.
The Gallery Club Lounge overlooks The Lobby and the Sunburst sculpture, surrounded by works by Philippine masters, and serves breakfast, afternoon tea and evening cocktails.
The Peninsula Halo-halo Harana is the hotel's version of the Filipino dessert halo-halo, served in a giant glass.
The hotel has a bespoke jeepney painted in Peninsula Brewster Green.
The Peninsula Spa offers traditional Filipino treatments such as the Hilot Massage with Ventosa.

considerations.text: The rooms are laid out between two wings, so it can be a bit of a hike getting to the elevators.
The hotel caters to a large events and meetings business, with events often happening in its ballrooms.
The spa has a minimum age of 18.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: The Peninsula Manila
